body.p: The bear. There lived an old man. The old woman say to her husband: "What does the belly(?) swell?" This woman gave birth to a child. This child was a girl without words [=dumb].[DCh]: Not clear why reflexive possessive suffix at "agiji". So this girl lived. One day the girl was sitting, she was sitting and eating, then she went off, she went off forever.[KAY:] 'Ð²Ñ£ÐºÑ' - means here apparently not 'always', not 'century', but 'forever'. The old man says: "Where did the girl go?" The old woman says: "It went there." The old people(?) are searching the girl. A bear came. The old man killed the bear. Having killed he takes off the fur. Then he saw at the bear's hands a silver bracelet, and at his neck a necklace. This silver bracelet and the necklace were presents to the girl. Now the bear, it is a human.
